# New Star Cleaning

> Locally owned house cleaning company in Fresno, California. Residential,
> office, and post-construction cleaning for Fresno, Clovis, Madera, and
> close-in Fresno neighborhoods including Tower District, Fig Garden, and
> Woodward Park. Call or text (559) 785-2822. Quotes are confirmed before
> anything is booked.

Key facts:

- Business: NEW STAR CLEANING LLC, 132 W Nees Ave Unit 106, Fresno, CA 93711
- Phone: (559) 785-2822 (call or text). Email: support@newstarcleaning.com
- Hours: Monday to Friday 8 AM to 6 PM, Saturday 8 AM to 5 PM, Sunday closed
- Cleaners bring supplies and equipment
- Pricing follows the agreed scope; oven, refrigerator, and cabinet interiors
  and interior window glass are priced add-ons, not hidden extras
- Not offered: laundry, dishes, organizing, packing, biohazard cleanup,
  exterior windows, carpet shampooing, restoration work
- Before/after photos on the site come from real New Star appointments; the
  site uses no stock photography

## Services

- [Standard recurring cleaning](https://newstarcleaning.com/services/standard-cleaning): weekly, bi-weekly, or monthly upkeep for maintained homes
- [Deep cleaning](https://newstarcleaning.com/services/deep-cleaning): detailed one-time reset, including under-sink cabinets, tracks, and baseboards
- [Move-in / move-out cleaning](https://newstarcleaning.com/services/move-out-cleaning): empty-home cleaning for tenants, landlords, buyers, and sellers
- [Post-construction cleaning](https://newstarcleaning.com/services/post-construction-cleaning): scoped final cleans for construction and renovation handoffs
- [Office and commercial cleaning](https://newstarcleaning.com/services/commercial-cleaning): walkthrough-based commercial work
